prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval grounded RPG LOW RES PIXEL ART location concept, elevated three-quarter cutaway. Coarse square pixel clusters, controlled dark outlines, restrained 3-tone stone timber wool iron, muted earth palette, no smooth painted surfaces or photorealism. No people, no text or labels, no quest UI, no magic, no outcome animation. Daylight. Room/prop geometry is a proposal, not certified collision, official geography, inventory or narrative outcome. Open ordinary return path remains visually distinct. TWO separate side-by-side room cutaways with slim neutral gutter, no claim of exact adjacency. LEFT a modest neutral meeting room: exactly THREE SHORT RECTANGULAR tables arranged around a conspicuously empty center, one small nomination token on EACH table, and ONE empty plain tenant stool distinctly set apart; no throne, raised dais, round five-chair table or political flags. RIGHT separate waiting gallery: three unlit ordinary small oil lamps separately mounted along an inner wall, two modest wooden screens create privacy pockets but leave a broad continuous aisle and TWO visibly open ordinary street exits at opposite ends. A small side table has closed unsent folded paper, no writing. All seats empty, no assumption of consent, attendance, sponsorship withdrawal, reconciliation or representation.
